title: Starry Atelier
description: An artist's studio interior with wooden easels, blank canvases, and a paint-splattered stool under a large skylight revealing a vibrant night sky filled with stars, constellations, a glowing comet, and dramatic beams of golden light streaming downward. In the foreground, one easel displays a finished painting of an empty minimalist gallery room.
